author: Aditi Kulkarni
comment: Sorry to be blunt, but your evaluation table is useless right now. 'Good' and 'bad' are not criteria, they're just feelings. Two people reading the same answer will give it different scores, and then your 70% figure means nothing. Write down what makes an answer good (correct facts, cites the right rule, says 'I don't know' when it should), score each answer against that, and have two people score separately. Then the table will actually be worth reading, and the rest of your report looks solid.

comment: We compared answers to 'Is attendance compulsory?' across three bots. Generic answers that sound right are a big risk for a college FAQ bot, so we've made 'college-specific accuracy' our most heavily weighted criterion.
